name: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, an Indian company founded in 1945 and headquartered in Mumbai, operates globally, delivering a diverse portfolio of mobility products and agricultural solutions. Its extensive operations are categorized into segments such as Automotive, Farm Equipment, Financial Services, Hospitality, and Real Estate. The Automotive division encompasses the manufacturing of a broad spectrum of vehicles, including passenger cars, commercial trucks, buses, vans, utility vehicles, and electric vehicles, alongside motorcycles, scooters, and watercraft. It also produces construction machinery like EarthMaster backhoe loaders and RoadMaster motor graders. Additionally, the company supplies parts and assemblies for the aerospace and defense sectors, while also providing complete land and naval systems, defense electronics, and security consulting. Services for pre-owned cars are also offered. Beyond vehicles, its Farm Equipment segment offers a range of agricultural machinery. The Financial Services arm provides a comprehensive suite of offerings, including retail, SME, and housing loans, mutual funds, insurance brokerage, and financing for vehicles and equipment. The Hospitality segment manages around 100 resorts and engages in timeshare and vacation ownership programs. Further operations include the M2All e-commerce platform, solar power projects, and logistics services. The company also delivers various consulting services, such as information security, risk management, engineering, and business process management, alongside general information technology services. Its Real Estate ventures involve the development and management of commercial complexes. Moreover, Mahindra & Mahindra is engaged in the production and trading of steel for automotive and industrial uses, and offers power backup solutions through diesel and gas generators.
